description: This script generates Excel reports of supported data models (USPs and CWMP) based on JSON data models and external definitions, including command-line interface for customization.

methods.name: is_dm_supported
methods.description: Checks if a data model object is supported based on a list.

methods.name: add_data_to_list_dm
methods.description: Appends data to the list in CSV format.

methods.name: parse_standard_object
methods.description: Recursively parses a standard data model object, supporting nested objects and parameters.

methods.name: parse_vendor_object
methods.description: Adds vendor-specific objects to the data model list.

methods.name: parse_object
methods.description: Loads JSON data model and parses each object.

methods.name: parse_object_tree
methods.description: Parses data models for USP and CWMP.

methods.name: generate_excel_sheet
methods.description: Creates an Excel sheet with styled data entries.

methods.name: generate_excel_file
methods.description: Generates the complete Excel file with USP and CWMP data models.

methods.name: generate_excel
methods.description: Main function to generate the data model Excel report.
